header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Load ROM
on a new profile once the shader list Chrome builds behind the launcher is done (Firefox builds none there, and its
line saying so is the one waited for), Start Game, the boot and the opening to the title with Start (Enter), then
Start to the main menu, VS Mode with the stick (S) and A (Space), and A on Start to character select, as a player
does. tools/shader_survey.js starts the battle from there as character select and stage select do: a time battle
of four computer players (Mario, Link, Pikachu, Ness) on Peach's Castle with items, a minute of the game's time on
its clock (dSYTaskmanUpdateCount, 60 a second), behind a need that fails the run unless that battle is playing,
then the battle's clock run out and its results (after Sudden Death if it ties). The scene the game is in is
gSCManagerSceneData.scene_curr (0x800A4AD0, its high byte), the main menu's cursor sMNModeSelectOption (0x80132C88)
and VS Mode's sMNVSModeCursorIndex (0x80134948). tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on to more stages, for when a
